blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.
blocks.zh: 超过数以万计的视觉符号引起注意,在视频传播变压器(DiTs)的推论中占主导地位. 现有方法通过相接性,低精度,或两者兼而有之来来降低这一成本,但对所有所保存的瓷砖使用单一精度. 我们观察到,由近似法引入的输出出错在不同的瓦片中差异很大. 许多瓦片可以略出小错误来跳出,其他的则必须计算,但获得的却很少超出低精度,少数甚至保留了低精度的重大错误. 我们提出Triage,一种免训练的注意方法,它分配出三个相近分层中的每个瓦片:通过用它的块来取而代之来跳过它,在NVFP4中去掉它,或者用NVFP4剩余校正来取精. 轻量级路由器从块统计中预测出每块下每块出错,只有在预测出错的减少证明额外计算合理时,才将一砖移动到更准确的地级,而以单一价格来决定这种取舍. 一个被熔化的内核在单传中执行所有三层,在RTX Blackwell GPU的FP4收音机核心上执行. 穿越Wan2.2,HunyuanVideo,和LTX-2.5,Triage在密集闪存上加速了最高2.32x的端到端生成,在5个环境中,每个环境运行速度都快于每个基线,同时达到比最高的PSNR基线高0.3-3.0分贝.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion transformers (DiTs) Peebles & Xie (2023) have become the backbone of video generation Kong et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; HaCohen et al. (2026) and world simulation Agarwal et al. (2025) ; Aditi et al. (2026) .
Recent video DiTs apply 3D full attention, in which every visual token attends to every other across all frames Yang et al. (2025b) ; Kong et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) , and a video yields tens of thousands of these tokens.
This attention has quadratic cost in the number of tokens and accounts for a large fraction of inference time, a share that grows as models move to higher resolutions and longer videos.

blocks.en:
Sparse attention and low-bit attention are the two main approaches to reducing this cost.
Both operate on tiles , each pairing a block of queries with a block of keys.
Sparse attention selects the tiles to compute and skips the rest, dropping them or approximating each by its mean key and value Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Yang et al. (2025a) ; Li et al. (2026) (Figure 1 a).
Low-bit attention instead computes every tile in a low-bit format such as FP8 or NVFP4 Zhang et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2025b) (Figure 1 b).
Methods that combine the two Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Zhao et al. (2025b) skip tiles and compute the kept ones in a low-bit format (Figure 1 c).

两者都用瓷砖操作,每块将一组查询与一组密钥对齐.
Sparse 注意选择瓷砖来计算和跳过其余的瓷砖,将瓷砖丢掉或按其平均键值和张等人(2025c)相近,杨等人(2025a),李等人(2026)(图1a).
相反,低位注意以低位格式计算每块瓦,如FP8或NVFP4 张等(2025a) ; 张等(2025b)(图1b).
将两个张等人(2025c)结合起来的方法; Zhao等人(2025b)跳过瓦片,以低位格式计算保存的瓦片(图1c).

blocks.en:
These approaches give a tile at most two options, skipping it or computing it at a single precision shared by every kept tile.
Which approach is most accurate depends on the row , the tiles that one query block attends to (Figure 1 ).
A row is sharp when its query block puts almost all of its attention on a few tiles, and diffuse when it spreads its attention over many.
At the same compute cost, sparse attention tends to be the most accurate on sharp rows, low-bit attention on diffuse rows, and their combination on rows in between.

这些方法最多提供了两个选项的瓦片,跳过,或者以每个保留瓦片共用的单一精度计算.
哪种方法最准确取决于行,一个查询块所处理的瓷砖(图1).
当它的查询块把几乎所有的注意力都放在几块瓷砖上时,一排是尖锐的,当它把注意力分散到许多瓷砖上时,它就会扩散.
在同样的计算成本下,稀疏的注意力往往在尖锐的排位上最为准确,在分散的排位上低位的注意力,以及它们在排位间的组合.

blocks.en:
Our key observation is that the output error from skipping a tile or computing it at low precision varies widely across tiles, even within the same row.
Because this error differs so much from tile to tile, extra computation should be judged by its marginal gain , the output error it removes per unit of additional compute.
Existing approaches, which share one precision across all computed tiles, cannot fully exploit these differences: they spend more compute than some tiles need while leaving substantial error on others that would benefit from additional computation.

由于这个错误在瓦片和瓦片之间差别很大,额外的计算应该根据其边际收益来判断,它去除每个单位的额外计算输出错误.

blocks.en:
We present Triage , which assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers, namely skip (block means), skim (NVFP4), and refine (NVFP4 with residual correction) (Figure 1 d).
Before each attention call, a router estimates each tile’s output error under each tier from block statistics and upgrades a tile only when its marginal gain is at least a price π \pi .
Under our error model, this rule reduces to comparing one score per tile against two thresholds, making the decision inexpensive and leaving π \pi as the single user-controlled parameter for the speed–fidelity trade-off.
A periodically rebuilt clustering tree groups similar queries and keys into tiles, keeping the block statistics representative and the cheaper approximations accurate.

Triage executes all three tiers in one fused kernel and refines selected tiles with additional NVFP4 residual products, which give nearly the same error as refining them in BF16 while keeping every tier on the FP4 tensor cores.

In Figure 2 d, Triage is both faster and more faithful to the dense video than all three methods, and across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5 it accelerates each attention call by up to 8.6 × \times and generation by up to 2.32 × \times over FlashAttention.

blocks.en: In summary, this paper makes the following contributions: • We show that existing approaches leave accuracy unexploited because approximation error varies widely across tiles, even within a row, motivating a per-tile choice by marginal gain (§ 3 ). • We propose three approximation tiers with a router that estimates each tile’s error under each tier and trades it against compute, and a clustering tree that groups similar tokens into each tile, lowering the error of skipping and skimming (§ 5 ). • We implement all three tiers in one fused kernel on FP4 tensor cores, representing skipped tiles as virtual tiles of block means and refining selected tiles with NVFP4 residual products (§ 6 ). • We evaluate Triage on four video DiTs in five settings and show that it achieves a better trade-off between speed and fidelity than all evaluated baselines (§ 7 ).

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Video Diffusion Transformers
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频传播变形器

blocks.en:
Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) iteratively denoise latent representations, which encode videos compressed spatially and temporally by a 3D VAE.
These latents are divided into patches that serve as visual tokens.
Recent video DiTs apply 3D full attention, in which every token attends to every other across all frames Yang et al. (2025b) ; Kong et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) .
This improves quality but makes the cost of attention quadratic in the total number of visual tokens.
blocks.zh:
视频传播变压器(DiTs) 迭代隐形表示,它用3D VAE在空间和时间上压缩视频.
这些潜伏物被分为作为视觉符号的补丁.
最近录影 DiTs应用了3D全注意,其中每一个符符都会在所有框架的杨等人(2025b)中互相关注;Kong等人(2024);Wang等人(2025).
这提高了质量,但使注意力费用在视觉标志的总数上达到四倍。

blocks.en: 2.2 Block-Sparse Attention
blocks.zh: 2.2 屏蔽层注意

blocks.en:
Attention kernels such as FlashAttention Dao et al. (2022) partition queries, keys, and values into blocks and process one tile at a time, where a tile pairs a query block with a key block.
An online softmax merges tiles one at a time, so a kernel can skip a tile or compute it differently without changing the others.
We call the set of tiles attended to by one query block a row .
For a row with query block ℐ \mathcal{I} and key blocks 𝒥 1 , … , 𝒥 N t \mathcal{J}_{1},\dots,\mathcal{J}_{N_{\mathrm{t}}} , the mass of tile t t is the share of the row’s attention that falls on it, m t = 1 | ℐ | ​ ∑ i ∈ ℐ ∑ j ∈ 𝒥 t P i ​ j , m_{t}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{I}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{I}}\sum_{j\in\mathcal{J}_{t}}P_{ij}, (1) where P P is the softmax attention matrix, so a row’s masses sum to one.
Block-sparse attention exploits the concentration of attention mass on a few keys Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Xu et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025a) : since each tile’s contribution to the output is weighted by its mass, it keeps the tiles with the largest estimated mass.
Because each row produces the output of its query block independently, these methods select tiles separately for each row.
Each row computes either a fixed number of tiles or enough tiles to cover a target share of its mass.

blocks.en:
Some methods fine-tune models to use sparse attention Zhang et al. (2025e) ; Zhang et al. (2026c) ; Zhang et al. (2026b) , but the additional training cost for each model motivates our focus on training-free methods.
Recent training-free methods use three techniques.
First, they select tiles dynamically for each input Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Yang et al. (2025a) ; Li et al. (2026) , since static masks such as the sliding windows of STA Zhang et al. (2025f) cannot adapt to attention patterns that vary across prompts, layers, and denoising steps.
To avoid computing all attention scores, these methods estimate tile masses using block averages of queries and keys.
Second, token clustering groups similar tokens into blocks to improve the accuracy of these estimates Yang et al. (2025a) ; Zhou et al. (2026) , a reordering that 3D full attention permits.
Applying k k -means to each input adapts the grouping to its tokens, unlike fixed arrangements such as 3D tiling or a Hilbert curve Zhang et al. (2025f) ; Zhang et al. (2025c) ; Zhao et al. (2025b) .
Third, mean-based approximations represent skipped tiles by their block means rather than discarding their contributions entirely Li et al. (2026) ; Zhou et al. (2026) .

blocks.en: 2.3 Low-Bit Attention and NVFP4
blocks.zh: 2.3 低体重注意力和NVFP4

blocks.en:
Low-bit attention reduces the cost of each computed tile by quantizing queries, keys, values, and probabilities for low-precision tensor-core operations.
NVFP4 represents each value in the 4-bit E2M1 format.
Each group of 16 consecutive values shares an E4M3 scale, and each tensor has an additional FP32 scale.
On Blackwell GPUs, the FP4 tensor cores run 4 × \times as fast as BF16 ones with FP32 accumulation on the RTX PRO 6000, and 8 × \times as fast on the RTX 5090.
blocks.zh:
低位关注通过对低精度的拉诺核心操作的查询、键、值和概率进行定量,降低每个计算瓦的成本。
NVFP4以4位E2M1格式表示每个值.
每组连续16个值共享一个E4M3比例尺,每个百合有额外的FP32比例尺.
在Blackwell GPU上,FP4的拉伸核心运行速度与BF16一样快,在RTX PRO 6000上积累FP32,在RTX 5090上运行速度为8×%.

blocks.en:
Outliers can inflate quantization scales and increase rounding error.
SageAttention2 mitigates this through query and key smoothing, which SageAttention3 also adopts Zhang et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2025b) .
We describe this computation below using the NVFP4 format of SageAttention3.
Let q ¯ \bar{q} be the mean query of a query block and k ¯ \bar{k} the mean key of a head.
Subtracting k ¯ \bar{k} shifts each query’s attention scores by a constant, leaving the softmax unchanged.
Centering the queries additionally requires a correction term.
Omitting the attention scaling factor, we approximate the smoothed scores as S ≈ 𝒬 ⁡ ( Q − q ¯ ) ​ 𝒬 ​ ( K − k ¯ ) ⊤ + q ¯ ​ ( K − k ¯ ) ⊤ , S\approx\mathcal{Q}(Q-\bar{q})\,\mathcal{Q}(K-\bar{k})^{\top}+\bar{q}\,(K-\bar{k})^{\top}, (2) where 𝒬 ⁡ ( X ) \mathcal{Q}(X) denotes the scaled values represented by NVFP4 quantization.
The correction term q ¯ ​ ( K − k ¯ ) ⊤ \bar{q}(K-\bar{k})^{\top} is computed in full precision.
The value product also uses quantized probabilities and values, while accumulation and the online softmax remain in FP32.

blocks.en: 3 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3 动机

blocks.en:
Existing sparse, low-bit, and combined attention methods typically compute all retained tiles at a single precision.
We analyze how approximation error varies, first across rows and then among tiles within a row, to identify opportunities for choosing sparsity and precision per tile.
blocks.zh:
现有的稀疏、低位和综合注意方法通常以单一的精度计算所有保留的瓦片。
我们分析近似误差如何不同,首先跨行,然后在一行的瓷砖中,找出每个瓷砖选择垃圾和精度的机会.

blocks.en:
We capture queries, keys, and values from dense runs of Wan2.2-TI2V-5B and HunyuanVideo, using four prompts, four denoising steps, and 10 and 15 layers, respectively (160 and 240 attention calls).
We measure the relative L2 error of each row’s output against dense attention.
We compare three allocations at 25% of the modeled cost of dense BF16 attention, assuming for simplicity that the cost of an operation scales with its bit width, so that 8-bit and 4-bit operations cost half and a quarter as much as BF16 ones.
Sparse attention (S) computes the heaviest 25% of each row’s tiles in BF16.
Combined attention (S+L) computes the heaviest 50% using the INT8 query–key and FP8 probability–value products of SageAttention2 Zhang et al. (2025a) .
Low-bit attention (L) computes all tiles in NVFP4 using SageAttention3 Zhang et al. (2025b) .
S and S+L select tiles by exact attention mass from dense attention and drop the rest, isolating allocation effects from mass-estimation error.
blocks.zh:

我们对照密集的注意力来测量每行输出的相对 L2 错误 。
我们比较了三笔分配款,按密集BF16注意的模型成本的25%计算,假设简单的是,一个具有比特宽度的操作尺度的成本,因此8位和4位操作的成本是比BF16的要高一半和四分之一.

To explain why the balance between these errors changes with the row’s attention distribution, we examine how approximating an individual tile changes the row’s output.

blocks.en: 3.2 Different Precisions Within a Row
blocks.zh: 3.2 行内不同的精度

blocks.en:
Within a row, increasing precision costs about the same across all equal-sized tiles, but can remove more output error from heavy tiles, those with large attention mass.
The mass–error relationship therefore motivates choosing precision per tile by its marginal gain, the output error removed per unit of additional compute.
blocks.zh:
在一行之内,所有等大小的瓷砖的精度成本都会增加,但可以从重瓦片中去除更多的输出错误,即那些有较大关注质量的瓷砖.
因此,质量-错误关系促使人们根据其边际收益选择每块精度,即额外计算单位的输出错误。

blocks.en:
A row can contain a few heavy tiles with large NVFP4 error and many moderate tiles that together hold too much mass to skip with little error.
Using NVFP4 for all kept tiles leaves error on the heavy ones, while raising precision for all also increases the cost of keeping the moderate tiles.
blocks.zh:

对所有保存的瓦片使用NVFP4会给重的瓦片留下错误,同时提高所有瓦片的精度也会增加保持中度瓦片的成本.

blocks.en: 4 Overview
blocks.zh: 4 概览

blocks.en:
Triage chooses one of three tiers for each tile. Skip replaces a light tile with the means of its keys and values, skim computes a moderate tile in NVFP4, and refine computes a heavy tile at higher precision.
Making this choice by marginal gain sets two goals.
The first is to predict the error of each tier with low overhead, without computing the attention scores.
Exact masses require the scores that skipping avoids, and the tokens within a tile vary, so cheap summaries such as block means can miss both a tile’s mass and its approximation error.
The second is to run the chosen tiers without losing the speed of low-bit computation.
Running the tiers in separate kernels requires merging their outputs, and higher precision usually comes from BF16, which runs at a fraction of the FP4 throughput.
Figure 5 shows how the two stages of Triage meet these goals.
blocks.zh:
Triage为每块瓷砖选择一个三级. 跳过用其键和值的手段替换一个轻瓦,在NVFP4中省略计算一个温和的瓦,并在更高的精度中精细计算一个重瓦.
通过边际收益作出这种选择有两个目标。
第一个是预测每层低管理费的错误,而不计算注意分数.
精确质量需要跳过避免的分数,而砖块内的符号则不同,因此块状手段等廉价摘要既会错过砖块的质量,也会错过其近似错误.
二是运行所选的阶梯,而不失去低位计算的速度.
在独立的内核中运行阶梯需要合并其输出,更高的精度通常来自BF16,它运行在FP4吞吐量的一小部分.
图5显示了Triage的两个阶段如何实现这些目标。

blocks.en:
Planning (§ 5 ) first groups similar queries and keys into fixed-size blocks with a clustering tree that repeatedly splits tokens along their principal direction, reducing the variation within each tile and thus the approximation error.
It then collects block statistics, including means, variances, and key–value covariances, to estimate tile mass and approximation error without computing all attention scores.
A router uses these estimates to choose the tier of each tile.
Statistics collection and routing are fused with smoothing and quantization, keeping the planning overhead small.
Planning outputs a tier map together with the block means and quantized operands that execution needs.
blocks.zh:
规划(§5)首先将类似的查询和密钥分组为固定大小的块,并带有一个集群树,沿其主要方向反复分割符号,减少每个瓦片内的变异,从而减少近似错误.
然后收集块统计,包括手段、差异和关键值共变,以估计瓦片质量和近似误差,而不计算所有注意分数。
一个路由器使用这些估计来选择每个瓦片的分级.
统计收集和路径与平稳和量化相结合,使规划的间接费用保持小幅。
规划输出一个分级地图,连同块手段和执行需要的量化操作。

blocks.en:
Execution (§ 6 ) combines all three tiers within one online softmax.
Skipped tiles contribute through their cluster means, which the kernel appends to the keys as virtual tiles, and skimmed tiles use NVFP4 products.
Refined tiles add NVFP4 products of the quantization residuals, which nearly match the accuracy of BF16.
blocks.zh:
执行(§ 6)将所有三个层次合并在一个在线软马克内.
跳过瓦片通过它们的集群手段贡献,内核附件作为虚拟瓦片对密钥,滑动的瓦片使用NVFP4产品.
炼制的瓷砖添加了量化残留的NVFP4产品,几乎与BF16的精度一致.

blocks.en: 5 Planning: Choosing Tiers
blocks.zh: 5 规划:选择等级

blocks.en: Planning must estimate the marginal gain of each tier with low overhead.
blocks.zh: 规划必须估计每一级间接费用低的边际收益。

blocks.en: 5.1 Tile-Aligned Clustering
blocks.zh: 5.1 瓦片组合

blocks.en:
Triage clusters similar queries and keys to improve both routing estimates and approximate computation.
Grouping dissimilar tokens makes block means less representative and can increase the errors from mean replacement and shared quantization scales.
Fixed token orders do not adapt to the input, while standard k k -means produces clusters of varying sizes, which the kernel’s fixed-size tiles must either pad or split. Triage therefore uses a divisive clustering tree that groups similar tokens while controlling block size.
blocks.zh:
triage将类似的查询和密钥分组,以改善路线估计和近似计算.
分组式的异形令块意味着代表性较小,并且可以从平均替换和共享的量化尺度中增加错误.
固定令牌命令不适应输入,而标准k k - 意思是产生大小不一的集群,内核的固定大小瓦片必须垫或拆分. 因此Triage使用一个分裂的集群树,在控制块大小的同时将相似的符号分组.

blocks.en:
Triage builds separate query and key trees for each head using principal direction divisive partitioning (PDDP) Boley (1998) .
Each node represents a group of tokens, and the root contains all queries or all keys of a head.
At each node, Triage estimates the principal direction and sorts the tokens by their projections onto it.
It then splits the sorted tokens near the midpoint, at a multiple of the target block size.
Splitting continues until each leaf holds one block, and only the final block may be partially filled.
The trees are rebuilt every five sparse steps.
Appendix A gives the full algorithm, including dimensionality reduction and principal-direction estimation.
blocks.zh:
Triage利用主要方向分裂分化(PDDP) Boley(1998年)为每个头建立单独的查询和关键树。
每个节点代表一组符号,根包含一个头的所有查询或所有键.
在每个节点,Triage通过预测对主要方向进行估计,并将符号排序到上面.
然后在中点附近,在目标块大小的倍数上,将排序的令牌分割.
分裂持续到每片叶片保持一个块,只有最后块可以部分填充.

The attention kernel processes tiles of 128 queries by 128 keys.
Query clusters contain 128 tokens, while key clusters contain 64 so that routing can use statistics from smaller key groups.
The router combines the statistics of two consecutive key clusters to assign one tier to each 128-key tile.
A skipped tile is represented by the mean keys and mean values of its two clusters.

blocks.en:
Estimating J t J_{t} , R t R_{t} , and m t m_{t} from block statistics lets planning share the preprocessing needed for quantization. Triage fuses statistics collection, mass estimation, and tier assignment with smoothing and quantization in a few Triton Tillet et al. (2019) passes grouped by operand.

These operations are memory-bound, so fusion avoids repeated reads of Q Q , K K , and V V ; tokens are accessed through the clustering tree’s index rather than a permuted copy.

blocks.en: 6.2 Refining Tiles on FP4 Tensor Cores
blocks.zh: 6.2 FP4 Tensor Cores上的精炼图纸

blocks.en:
A refined tile needs higher accuracy than a skimmed one, which could come from BF16 in two ways.
A second BF16 kernel over the refined tiles would need an extra launch, load Q Q and write the output a second time, and add a merge pass.
BF16 products inside the same kernel would avoid these costs, but BF16 tensor cores are several times slower than the FP4 ones (§ 2.3 ). Triage instead refines tiles on the FP4 tensor cores, where three FP4 products still take less time than one BF16 product at peak rates.
blocks.zh:
精制的瓷砖需要比滑动的瓷砖更高的精度,这种精度可以从两个方面来自BF16.
精制瓷砖之上的第二个BF16内核需要额外的发射,加载QQ并第二次写入输出,并增加一个合并通道.
同一内核内的BF16产品可以避免这些成本,但BF16的拉伸核心比FP4的多倍慢(§2.3). 3个FP4产品在峰值速率下仍比一个BF16产品耗时少。

6.3 Attention Kernel
blocks.zh: 6.3 关注核心

blocks.en:
We implement the kernel for sm_120, the architecture of the RTX Blackwell GPUs that we evaluate, in the CuTe DSL of CUTLASS NVIDIA (2026) .
It extends a warp-specialized NVFP4 attention kernel on 128-query by 128-key tiles, in which one producer warp loads operands through the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) and eight MMA warps add each NVFP4 product to the full-precision smoothing correction of ( 2 ).

blocks.en: Query blocks differ in cost, which the kernel estimates from their kept and refined tiles, so the persistent kernel deals them to cooperative thread arrays (CTAs) in a snake order, largest first, to spread costly blocks evenly.

blocks.en: Together with the preprocessing kernels, the attention kernel forms a drop-in backend that replaces the self-attention call of each transformer block, so Triage plugs into pipelines such as SGLang Diffusion Zheng et al. (2024) ; SGLang Team (2025) without changing the model.

blocks.en: 7 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 7. 评价

blocks.en: 7.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 7.1 设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate four video DiTs from three families in five settings, each on a single Blackwell GPU (Table 1 ).
The RTX 5090 (32 GB) runs Wan2.2-TI2V-5B Wang et al. (2025) at 720p and HunyuanVideo Kong et al. (2024) at 540p, with FP8 weights for HunyuanVideo to fit in memory.
The RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB) runs Wan2.2-T2V-A14B, HunyuanVideo at 720p, and LTX-2.5 HaCohen et al. (2026) for image-to-video generation, all in BF16 at their official settings.
The models run 50 denoising steps (40 for Wan2.2-T2V-A14B), and LTX-2.5 runs eight stage-1 steps and three stage-2 steps.
Every method runs in SGLang Diffusion 0.5.20 SGLang Team (2025) with PyTorch 2.13 and CUDA 13.0 on Ubuntu 24.04, and replaces only the self-attention over the visual tokens; the dense reference runs FlashAttention-2 Dao (2024) .

我们评价四个视频 3个家庭的DiT在5个设置中,每个设置在一个单一的Blackwell GPU上(表1).
RTX 5090(32 GB)运行 湾2.2-TI2V-5B Wang et al. (2025) at 720p,HunyuanVideo Kong et al. (2024) at 540p,对HunyuanVideo的FP8重量以适应记忆.
RTX PRO 6000(96 GB)运行于Wan2.2-T2V-A14B,HunyuanVideo at 720p,以及LTX-2.5 HaCohen等人(2026),用于图像到视频生成,全部在官方场合为BF16.

每一种方法在SGLang Difusion 0.5.20 SGLang Team(2025)中运行,在Ubuntu 24.04上配有PyTorch 2.13和CUDA 13.0,并仅取代视觉标志上的自留;密集参考运行FlashAtenty-2 Dao(2024).

For fidelity, we report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS against the dense video, averaged over frames, and for quality the mean of five VBench dimensions.
For speed, we report the speedup over dense of the end-to-end latency and of each attention call (Figure 8 ).

blocks.en: 7.2 End-to-End Performance
blocks.zh: 7.2 端到端业绩

blocks.en:
In each of the five settings of Table 1 , one price of Triage is faster end to end than every baseline and also closer to the dense video in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS: π = 0.15 \pi=0.15 in the three settings where it runs, and π = 0.3 \pi=0.3 in the other two.
At π = 0.15 \pi=0.15 , Triage computes more tiles than the sparse baselines, 28–35%, but refines only 8–10% of all tiles, and its PSNR is 0.8–3.0 dB above that of SVG-EAR, the baseline with the highest fidelity.
SVG-EAR reaches only 1.12–1.61 × \times , because it clusters the tokens with k k -means and computes its kept tiles in BF16.
At π = 0.3 \pi=0.3 , Triage is the fastest method in every setting, at 1.38–2.32 × \times , and its PSNR is still 0.4–8.0 dB higher than that of SpargeAttn and Sol-Attn, the fastest baselines; on both HunyuanVideo settings and LTX-2.5, it also exceeds SVG-EAR in PSNR while computing fewer tiles.
In the sweep of Figure 7 , Triage Pareto-dominates every baseline setting except SVG-EAR with the original cluster counts on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, which has higher fidelity than every setting of Triage but is slower than all of them.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
Triage shows that sparse and low-bit attention need not be competing choices: deciding for each tile whether to skip, skim, or refine it lets attention spend precision according to the estimated error reduction.
A lightweight router makes this choice from block statistics, and one fused kernel runs all three tiers on the FP4 tensor cores.
Across three families of video DiTs, Triage achieves a better trade-off between speed and fidelity than existing methods, without retraining or modifying the model.
As attention takes a growing share of generation with longer and higher-resolution videos, choosing precision tile by tile becomes increasingly important for making video generation practical.
blocks.zh:
Triage显示,很少和低位的注意力不需要是相互竞争的选择:决定每块瓷砖是跳过,滑动,还是精细,让注意力根据估计的减错量精确地花费.
一个轻量级路由器从块统计中作出这个选择,一个引信内核在FP4的拉诺核心上运行所有三个层次.
3个影视家庭 迪兹 三合会比现有方法在速度和忠诚之间实现更好的权衡,不进行再培训或修改模型.
由于关注使用更长和更高分辨率的视频的一代比例越来越大,用瓦片选择精密的瓦片对于视频生成实用性越来越重要.

blocks.en:
Figure 10 shows how the tiers follow the entropy of a row.
Every quintile contains all three tiers: on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, the router skips 61–84% of the tiles and refines 3–12% in every quintile.
What changes with entropy is where the mass lies.
In sharp rows (Q1), the refined tiles hold 95% of the mass on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B and 79% on HunyuanVideo, as § 3.2 suggests.
In diffuse rows (Q5), the router refines at most 3% of the tiles and splits the mass between skimmed tiles and many skipped tiles, each of which holds little mass.
